params.name: Tansyhook Crossing
params.description: A busy meeting of two public orchard lanes at a narrow timber bridge over an irrigation channel. A roofed weighing shed and fruit-cart layby stand beside the lane; the canal road continues downhill past hedge-grown orchards.
params.culture: Orchard Vales in the Asterwyn Crown: family orchards, seasonal harvest work, draft-beast caravans and barges use the adjoining country roads.
